_comment: Drop-in for agent-sync's mcp dropins dir, the same shape as the base servers.json. The server is launched through the wrapper beside this file, which resolves the token outside the sandbox, cd-s to /, scrubs the environment and execs github-mcp-server through srt-run with ~/.config/srt/github-mcp.json. A second instance for a GitHub Enterprise host is the same wrapper with that host as its argument, in a drop-in a profile-gated source ships.
